scope.description: Character 596 complete root display list plus AS3-created character 200/34 upgrade and reset confirmations. Shared ts/alert feedback is referenced as host behavior and is not falsified as a 596 child.

provenance.locator: character 596 export.strength.SutraInterface frame 1; dynamic confirmations character 200 updataFBWithLvdyl and character 34 renewalseThisSZ; direct DefineSprite PlaceObject depth/matrix; FFDec 26 selective SVG/PNG/button export.
fbClick constructs SutraInterface only when P1 current zbfb exists; otherwise shared alert.
SymbolClass maps 596/200/34; character tags and nested PlaceObject records cross-check generator parsing.

states.entry: P1 N or HUD magic-weapon button without equipped zbfb
states.fixtureId: p1; zbfb=null; RoleInfo alerts and does not construct 596

states.entry: P1 opens equipped level-1 magic weapon
btn_sj succeeds on the immediate soul branch
btn_sj on immediate branch with insufficient soul
states.fixtureId: p1; soul below level^2*1000; shared ts feedback

states.entry: nobtn removes the upgrade confirmation without mutation
refreshWX nobtn removes confirmation without mutation
refreshWX okbtn with fewer than three wpccfq
states.fixtureId: p1; wpccfq<3; shared alert; character-34 remains

states.fixtureId: p1; wpccfq>=3; element reset; level preserved

states.entry: Original input map has no P2 magic-weapon page shortcut
states.fixtureId: p2; no page instance; negative original evidence
